items.title: Buddy Burns Interview, 1958-08-14
items.q: Yank was playing trombone... I call uh... Carl Yank... Yeah.

ctx.x: Who else was in the band?

Uh... The Lib was on bass and Nene was on drum. And... Tick Chambers was uh... Playing trumpet. And uh... Yank was playing trombone. And uh... Oh... Emmet was playing guitar. And... Let's see... Uh... Who else? Oh... Freddie... Freddie Kepard... Playing... Playing uh... Cornet or... Cornet or...
